statements.impact_statement: The advisory: minimatch before 11.0.1 expands attacker-controlled **/.. segments in firstPhasePreProcess() and compares them pairwise in secondPhasePreProcess(), run at optimizationLevel 2 or higher. Those functions and the optimizationLevel option arrived with the minimatch 7+ rewrite; 3.1.5 is the old single-file implementation. Verified 2026-11-01 on the npm tarball minimatch-3.1.5.tgz: grep -c 'firstPhasePreProcess\|optimizationLevel' package/minimatch.js returned 0. The 10.x copies in this image are overridden to 11.0.1 instead (melange.yaml).

The advisory: i18next before 26.3.4 recurses through inherited built-ins in deepExtend (src/utils.js), reached only when an application passes attacker-controlled data to addResourceBundle(lng, ns, data, deep, overwrite) with deep and overwrite both true. Ghost 6.67.0 and 6.78.0 call addResourceBundle with three arguments only (packages/i18n/src/i18n-core.ts:103, resources from Ghost's own generated locale files), so deep and overwrite stay false and deepExtend never runs. Theme locale files are parsed into flat string records (packages/i18n/src/theme-resources.ts) and never deep-merged. Verified 2026-11-24 on the TryGhost/Ghost v6.67.0 and v6.78.0 sources.
